name: czgame_frame_is_window_valid
description: CZGameFrame::IsWindowValid returns false for a null window and otherwise returns the inverted result of the window provider's validity query slot.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja still exposes the MSVC neg/sbb/inc boolean idiom and the provider call as an indirect slot at vtable offset 0x10.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4438a0 validates null input returning 0, non-null input dispatch through the pointed object's vtable slot 0x10, and return of 1 only when that provider call returns 0.
The dependency frontier for 0x4438a0 has no direct callee blockers; the indirect provider slot contract is covered by the native smoke.
The native smoke verifies null input, provider-zero returning valid, and provider-nonzero returning invalid.
